page.notes: Marginal note 1 is in the left margin, beside the word "Toletum"; the printed reference "17." is partly unclear and is marked [?]. The reading "Congruo" in the italic phrase and "contu-" at the line end are clear enough, but the ligature forms in "Meritum" were checked only at normal resolution.
